# Chatham Heating and Cooling

> Chatham Heating and Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Chatham, Chatham-Kent, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.
